name: rules.waterlevel

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Exact case-sensitive local currency match; repeat for alternatives. Acquisition always retains the full native scope.

get.description: Query native detail by aliasName; reads online without changing saved lists.

purpose: Inspect native configuration through inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: bufferId
fields.meaning: Native row identity, retained without conversion.

fields.name: aliasName
fields.meaning: Native account alias used for get; distinct from bufferId.

limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant. Native fields, nested values, exact decimals and unknown fields are retained.
Native get sends aliasName as a string to GET /bankAccountBufferListByAliasName.json; no implicit list lookup.
List uses rowStart offsets with pageSize=5000 and null credit-date bounds. No page echoes; fixed result.count and raw/unique agreement prove coverage.
Get returns the native account-scoped dataValue object array. Every row must echo the requested aliasName. The envelope count is not the detail cardinality.
